messages.author: 0f9a753e88672b5d
messages.subject: Shiny Leaflet
parts:
Is there still progress being made on Shiny Leaflet?

Specifically, is there interest / someone already attempting to write in one of the full-screen plugins for Leaflet in Shiny? I'm not currently confident I will be able to write it in if it isn't already available and want to make sure I don't waste any time if it is.

https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.fullscreen
https://github.com/brunob/leaflet.fullscreen

These are the two fullscreen plugins I have found that seem to be "most" popular.
